title: Inside the studio
description: One of artist's studio is located in Moscow, in a unique Neo-Gothic mansion owned by classical musicians. This space houses about three tons of colored glass and is where many objects are created, making up the majority of his work. The second artist's studio is in Berlin, at the Direktorenhaus, which is a museum of handcrafted art. Currently, having left Russia some time ago, the artist is actively in search of properly suitable place in Berlin for a larger, permanent space where he can manage the full cycle of work, store all of the glass, handle metal production, and more.
